settings.label: Search source (wyy / kuwo / all)
settings.help: wyy = NetEase Cloud Music, kuwo = Kuwo, all = both. Leave empty for all.

settings.label: Download quality (lossless / high / standard)
settings.help: Overrides the app's playback quality for this plugin. Leave empty to follow the app setting. lossless = FLAC, high = MP3 320, standard = MP3 128.
